recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future updates to the complete usage list should continue to come from generated reference-list machinery rather than from another narrative list on the ValueSet page.
issue_request: FHIR-18562 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocabulary change request for the ValueSet page. The ballot comment asked whether the short lists in Boundaries and Relationships and the Intensional vs Extensional area were complete or only samples, and the recorded resolution was to make sure the list is complete.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to git 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249. That commit changed the ValueSet Boundaries wording from an ambiguous two-resource list naming ElementDefinition and Questionnaire to text that says ValueSets are used by many resources, names examples, and points readers to the full list below.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to vocab. The current ValueSet page includes a generated References to this Resource section listing Resource References and Extension References, and the current Intensional vs Extensional text defines the two styles without presenting a misleading resource list. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current source and generated page already resolve the completeness ambiguity, and adding another hand-maintained complete list would duplicate generated content.
